title: FedRAMP Moderate Marketplace no longer displays its previously observed Certified Services list
problem: The rendered Moderate overview showed FedRAMP Certified and N/A under Certified Services after navigation and reload. The November 6 bounded audit retained a named list including Platform, ES, ITSI and SOAR. The rendered High overview still lists Private Connectivity, Platform, ES and ITSI. Current Moderate component scope cannot be re-established from the display alone. The display establishes neither loss nor gain of certification, edition entitlement or customer authorization. High SOAR remains unestablished.

products: Splunk Cloud Platform FedRAMP Moderate CSO
audiences: Readers verifying public Moderate offering component scope
exclusions: No certification revocation, component removal, entitlement, deployment, High SOAR scope, or customer authorization is established.

scopeComparison: A November 7 public display differs from the dated November 6 display. The High listing and the dated vendor audit matrix are separate evidence.

impact.customerScenario: A reader checking whether the public Moderate offering lists an individual service.
impact.consequence: Treat the previously observed Moderate component list as dated and the current display as inconclusive for individual services.

confidence.rationale: The two dated observations establish a public display discrepancy. The reason, duration and current underlying scope are unknown.
